metaTitle: Approved Supplier Network | Bio Vera — Agricultural Inputs
metaDescription: Bio Vera works with selected agricultural input and packaging suppliers to support producers operating under defined production programmes.

hero.title: Join the Bio Vera Approved Supplier Network
hero.subtitle: Bio Vera works with selected agricultural input, packaging and technical suppliers to support producers operating under defined production programmes. Where technical integration is available, producers will be able to access programme-approved products through the Bio Vera platform.

whoApply.title: Who Should Apply
whoApply.intro: Established companies in the agri sector — distributors, agricultural retailers or operators with warehouse infrastructure and an existing network in the region. We seek partners who can provide field-level support and distribution under Bio Vera standards.

yourRole.title: Your Role
yourRole.intro: Regional operations partner within the Bio Vera network. You manage distribution of certified inputs, provide field-level support to growers and uphold quality standards locally. Coordination with the central team through the Vera Admin Panel.

cards.title: Approved catalogue integration
cards.description: Programme-approved products listed for participating producers subject to commercial agreement.

cards.title: Product & technical data
cards.description: Structured product information connected to production and batch documentation where integrated.

cards.title: Regional fulfilment
cards.description: Serve producers in your region within Bio Vera production programmes.

cards.title: Optional order integration
cards.description: Where technical integration is available, producers can access approved inputs through the Bio Vera system.

cards.title: Programme alignment
cards.description: Participate in a supplier-neutral operating system — no exclusive permanent supplier status implied.

paymentTermsNote: Commercial terms, payment conditions and payment dates are agreed individually within the relevant supplier agreement or purchase order.

howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.subtitle: Approved suppliers provide programme-aligned inputs and packaging. Where integrated, transactions can be tracked through the Bio Vera system.

requirements.title: Programme Requirements
requirements.subtitle: Dry, secure storage for Vera seeds, fertilizers and packaging. QR scanning mandatory for every dispatch. Physical verification of received goods. Digital-only record keeping through the Vera Admin Dashboard.

application.title: Supplier Application
application.intro: Apply online. You receive a reference code to track your application. Our team contacts you to schedule a meeting; upon approval we create your partner store account.
application.receivedBody: We will contact you to schedule a conversation. Save your reference number — you can use it to check your application status anytime.
